question_i18n.uz: Sud-tibbiyot eksperti o‘pka preparatida alveolyar organizatsiyalanuvchi fibroz topdi. Bu qaysi DAD bosqichini bildiradi?

explanation_i18n.uz: Tadqiqotda har qanday alveolyar organizatsiyalanuvchi fibroz mavjudligi eksudativ bosqichni proliferativ bosqichdan ajratuvchi asosiy mezon deb qabul qilingan. DAD ‘diffuz alveolyar shikast’ degani.

source.author: Urer et al.
source.title: Diffuse Alveolar Damage of the Lungs in Forensic Autopsies: Assessment of Histopathological Stages and Causes of Death, The Scientific World Journal

question_i18n.uz: Diffuz alveolyar shikast (DAD) qaysi kasallikning morfologik prototipi hisoblanadi?

explanation_i18n.uz: Manbaga ko‘ra DAD o‘tkir interstitsial pnevmoniyaning morfologik prototipi bo‘lib, tez va o‘lim bilan tugaydigan klinik kechishi bilan xarakterlanadi.

source.author: Urer et al.
source.title: Diffuse Alveolar Damage of the Lungs in Forensic Autopsies: Assessment of Histopathological Stages and Causes of Death, The Scientific World Journal

question_i18n.uz: Bemorda o‘pka rentgenida ikki tomonlama diffuz xiralashuv, chuqur gipoksemiya va mexanik ventilyatsiya zarurati bor. DAD klinik jihatdan qaysi sindrom sifatida namoyon bo‘ladi?

explanation_i18n.uz: Manbada DAD klinik jihatdan o‘tkir respirator distress sindromi (ARDS) sifatida namoyon bo‘lishi, rentgenda ikki tomonlama diffuz xiralashuv kuzatilishi aytilgan.

source.author: Urer et al.
source.title: Diffuse Alveolar Damage of the Lungs in Forensic Autopsies: Assessment of Histopathological Stages and Causes of Death, The Scientific World Journal

question_i18n.uz: Patolog sud-tibbiy autopsiyadagi DAD o‘pka preparatini gematoksilin-eozin bilan bo‘yab qayta baholamoqda. U qaysi mezonlarga tayanadi?

uz: Dallas mezonlari bo‘yicha miokardit tashxisi mezonlari
2002 yilgi ATS/ERS idiopatik interstitsial pnevmoniya mezonlari

explanation_i18n.uz: Preparatlar 2002 yilgi ATS/ERS (Amerika Torakal Jamiyati va Yevropa Respirator Jamiyati) idiopatik interstitsial pnevmoniya konsensus mezonlari asosida qayta ko‘rilgan. Boshqa variantlar yurak (miokard) mezonlari.

source.author: Urer et al.
source.title: Diffuse Alveolar Damage of the Lungs in Forensic Autopsies: Assessment of Histopathological Stages and Causes of Death, The Scientific World Journal

question_i18n.uz: Idiopatik o‘pka fibrozi va og‘ir nafas buzilishi bor bemorda ochiq o‘pka biopsiyasining qaysi xavfi sud-tibbiy autopsiyani muqobil qiladi?

explanation_i18n.uz: Ochiq biopsiya idiopatik o‘pka fibrozi bor bemorlarda o‘tkir xurujni qo‘zg‘atishi mumkin va og‘ir nafas buzilishida cheklangan. Shuning uchun sud-tibbiy autopsiya muqobil tadqiqot sohasi sifatida ko‘riladi.

source.author: Urer et al.
source.title: Diffuse Alveolar Damage of the Lungs in Forensic Autopsies: Assessment of Histopathological Stages and Causes of Death, The Scientific World Journal

question_i18n.uz: Patologga ikkita o‘pka preparati berildi, ikkalasida ham gialin membrana bor. Ekssudativ va proliferativ fazani ajratishda qaysi belgi asosiy mezon hisoblanadi?

uz: Alveolyar ekssudat va shish darajasining kuchi

explanation_i18n.uz: Tadqiqotda alveolalarda har qanday organizatsiyalanuvchi fibroz borligi ekssudativ fazani proliferativ fazadan ajratuvchi asosiy mezon deb qabul qilingan. Gialin membrana ikkala fazada ham uchraydi, shuning uchun u ajratuvchi mezon emas.

source.author: Urer et al.
source.title: Diffuse Alveolar Damage of the Lungs in Forensic Autopsies: Assessment of Histopathological Stages and Causes of Death, The Scientific World Journal

question_i18n.uz: Diffuz alveolyar shikastlanishda (DAD) gialin membrana (HM) rivoji jarohatdan keyin taxminan qachon namoyon bo‘ladi?

uz: Jarohatdan keyin dastlabki bir necha soatda

explanation_i18n.uz: Muhokamada gialin membrana rivoji shikastlanishdan 4-5 kun o‘tgach namoyon bo‘lishi qayd etilgan. Shu sababli u keyingi (proliferativ) fazada ko‘proq uchraydi.

source.author: Urer et al.
source.title: Diffuse Alveolar Damage of the Lungs in Forensic Autopsies: Assessment of Histopathological Stages and Causes of Death, The Scientific World Journal

question_i18n.uz: Patolog DAD holatida proliferativ faza ehtimolini baholamoqda. Logistik regressiyada proliferativ faza foydasiga mustaqil bashorat qilgan yagona belgi qaysi?

explanation_i18n.uz: Bir o‘zgaruvchili taqqoslashda bir nechta belgi proliferativ holatlarda yuqori edi. Logistik regressiyada esa faqat alveolyar fibrin mustaqil bashorat qiluvchi bo‘ldi (P = 0,016).

source.author: Urer et al.
source.title: Diffuse Alveolar Damage of the Lungs in Forensic Autopsies: Assessment of Histopathological Stages and Causes of Death, The Scientific World Journal

question_i18n.uz: DAD preparatida alveolalar va septalarda neytrofillar juda kam. Faqat shu belgiga tayanib, qaysi differensial tashxis istisno qilinadi?

uz: Fonda UIP ning o‘tkir avj olishi

explanation_i18n.uz: Mualliflar alveolalar va septalarda neytrofillar kamligi tufayli yondosh bakterial pnevmoniyani istisno qilgan. Boshqa holatlar boshqa belgilar (fibroz, honeycomb, eozinofil mikroabssesslar, gialin membrana) asosida farqlanadi.

source.author: Urer et al.
source.title: Diffuse Alveolar Damage of the Lungs in Forensic Autopsies: Assessment of Histopathological Stages and Causes of Death, The Scientific World Journal

question_i18n.uz: Sud-tibbiy yorishda o‘pkada DAD aniqlandi. O‘lim sababini faqat shu topilma asosida belgilash mumkinmi?

uz: Ha, DAD o‘zi yetarli bo‘lib, qo‘shimcha ma’lumot talab qilinmaydi
Yo‘q, DAD hayotlik tibbiy va sud-tibbiy ma’lumotlar bilan baholanadi
Ha, gialin membrana bo‘lsa, o‘lim sababi aniq deb hisoblanadi
Yo‘q, DAD hech qachon o‘lim mexanizmi bilan bog‘lanmaydi

explanation_i18n.uz: DAD bitta kasallikka xos emas, bir nechta omildan paydo bo‘ladigan umumiy o‘zgarish. Shuning uchun o‘lim sababini aniqlash uchun hayotlik davridagi tibbiy va sud-tibbiy ma’lumotlar birgalikda baholanishi kerak.

source.author: Urer et al.
source.title: Diffuse Alveolar Damage of the Lungs in Forensic Autopsies: Assessment of Histopathological Stages and Causes of Death, The Scientific World Journal

question_i18n.uz: Bosh jarohati olgan bemorda o‘tkir nafas yetishmovchiligi rivojlandi. Quyidagi mexanizmlardan qaysi biri aynan bosh jarohatiga xos?

explanation_i18n.uz: Travmada nafas yetishmovchiligi bir necha yo‘l bilan rivojlanadi. Jarohat boshda bo‘lsa, nafas markaziga ta’sir qiladi. Dori toksikligi zaharlanishga, anesteziya jarrohlikka, zaharli gazlar yong‘inga xos mexanizmlardir.

source.author: Urer et al.
source.title: Diffuse Alveolar Damage of the Lungs in Forensic Autopsies: Assessment of Histopathological Stages and Causes of Death, The Scientific World Journal

question_i18n.uz: Klinikada ARDS (o‘tkir respirator distress sindromi) bo‘lgan shaxs autopsiyasida diffuz alveolyar shikast (DAD) topilmadi. Qaysi xulosa to‘g‘ri?

uz: DAD topilmasligi ARDSni to‘liq inkor etadi
Bu holat ARDS tashxisini yanada kuchaytiradi
Bunda o‘lim sababi aniq o‘pkadan emas, deyiladi

explanation_i18n.uz: ARDS klinik ko‘rinishi bor shaxslarning taxminan yarmida autopsiyada DAD aniqlanadi. Shuning uchun DAD yo‘qligi ARDSni inkor etmaydi. DAD ko‘p omilli o‘zgarish bo‘lgani uchun faqat u o‘lim sababini aniqlashga yetmaydi.

source.author: Urer et al.
source.title: Diffuse Alveolar Damage of the Lungs in Forensic Autopsies: Assessment of Histopathological Stages and Causes of Death, The Scientific World Journal

question_i18n.uz: Pichoqlanishdan 1 soatdan kam yashab o‘lgan shaxs miokardida yallig‘lanish topildi. Du Long va hamkorlari tuzilmasida bu holat qaysi guruhga kiradi?

explanation_i18n.uz: 1-guruhga aniq g‘ayritabiiy o‘lim sababi bor, omon qolish vaqti 1 soatdan kam shaxslar kiritilgan, masalan pichoqlash yoki otilish. Ularda miokard yallig‘lanishi tasodifiy topilma deb baholangan.

source.author: du Long et al.
source.title: The histopathological spectrum of myocardial inflammation in relation to circumstance of death: a retrospective cohort study in clinical and forensic autopsies, Forensic Sciences Research

question_i18n.uz: Gistologik kesmada ≥10 yallig‘lanish hujayrasidan iborat bitta o‘choq va kardiomiotsit shikastlanishi bor. Basso tasnifi bo‘yicha bu qaysi tur?

explanation_i18n.uz: Fokal miokardit deb kamida bitta kesmada ≥10 hujayrali o‘choq va miotsit shikastlanishi borligi aytiladi. Chegaraviy shaklda miotsit shikasti bo‘lmaydi. Multifokalda o‘choqlar bir nechta bo‘ladi. Diffuz shaklda esa yallig‘lanish keng tarqalgan bo‘ladi.

source.author: du Long et al.
source.title: The histopathological spectrum of myocardial inflammation in relation to circumstance of death: a retrospective cohort study in clinical and forensic autopsies, Forensic Sciences Research

question_i18n.uz: Preparatda aniq o‘choqlarsiz, diffuz tarqalgan yallig‘lanish bor. Kitulwatte yallig‘lanish indeksi qiymati qanday chiqadi?

explanation_i18n.uz: Indeks o‘choqlar sonini kesmalar soniga bo‘lish bilan hisoblanadi. Diffuz yallig‘lanishda aniq o‘choq bo‘lmagani uchun indeks 0 chiqadi. Bu yallig‘lanish yo‘qdek yanglish taassurot beradi, shuning uchun indeks faqat diffuz bo‘lmagan turlarda qo‘llanadi.

source.author: du Long et al.
source.title: The histopathological spectrum of myocardial inflammation in relation to circumstance of death: a retrospective cohort study in clinical and forensic autopsies, Forensic Sciences Research

question_i18n.uz: Kuzatuvchi ichi kelishuvda o‘choqlar soni uchun Cohen kappasi qancha bo‘lgan?

explanation_i18n.uz: O‘choqlar soni uchun κ = 0,85 (miotsit shikasti — 0,96, fibroz — 0,88, qon quyilishi — 0,92); κ > 0,80 kuchli kelishuv hisoblangan.

source.author: du Long et al.
source.title: The histopathological spectrum of myocardial inflammation in relation to circumstance of death: a retrospective cohort study in clinical and forensic autopsies, Forensic Sciences Research

question_i18n.uz: Kuyishdan o‘lgan holatda o‘tkir eozinofil pnevmoniya (AEP) nega inkor etilgan?

uz: Eozinofil mikroabssess, diffuz HM va II tur pnevmotsit giperplaziyasi yo‘q edi

explanation_i18n.uz: Bitta kuyish holatida o‘rtacha eozinofil infiltratsiya bor edi, ammo eozinofil mikroabssess, diffuz gialin membrana va II tur pnevmotsit giperplaziyasining yo‘qligi AEP ni inkor etdi.

source.author: Urer et al.
source.title: Diffuse Alveolar Damage of the Lungs in Forensic Autopsies: Assessment of Histopathological Stages and Causes of Death, The Scientific World Journal

question_i18n.uz: Patolog infiltratda makrofaglar ustunligini tasdiqlamoqchi. Qaysi immunogistokimyoviy bo‘yoq mos keladi?

explanation_i18n.uz: Tadqiqotda CD45 limfotsitlarni, CD68 makrofaglarni, miyeloperoksidaza (MPO) esa neytrofillarni ko‘rsatish uchun ishlatilgan. Shuning uchun makrofaglar uchun CD68 tanlanadi. HE (gematoksilin-eozin) umumiy bo‘yoq bo‘lib, hujayra turini aniq ajratmaydi.

source.author: du Long et al.
source.title: The histopathological spectrum of myocardial inflammation in relation to circumstance of death: a retrospective cohort study in clinical and forensic autopsies, Forensic Sciences Research

question_i18n.uz: Uch guruh orasida qaysi belgi statistik jihatdan ishonchli farq ko‘rsatdi (P = 0.021)?

uz: O‘tkir diffuz miokardit uchragan holatlar soni

explanation_i18n.uz: O‘tkir diffuz miokardit deyarli faqat 2- va 3-guruhlarda topilgan (mos ravishda 9 va 7 holat), 1-guruhda esa bor-yo‘g‘i 1 holat. Chegaraviy, fokal va multifokal turlar guruhlar orasida sezilarli farq bermagan.

source.author: du Long et al.
source.title: The histopathological spectrum of myocardial inflammation in relation to circumstance of death: a retrospective cohort study in clinical and forensic autopsies, Forensic Sciences Research

question_i18n.uz: 3-guruhda faqat miokardit topilgan o‘lim holati baholanmoqda. Ekspert nima qilishi kerak?

uz: Toksikologik va genetik sabablarni istisno qilish
Miokarditni darhol yagona o‘lim sababi deb yozish

explanation_i18n.uz: Muallifler miokarditning ahamiyati ba‘zan oshirib baholanishi mumkinligini ta‘kidlaydi. Gistologiyaning o‘zi tasodifiy va o‘limga olib kelgan miokarditni ishonchli ajratmaydi. Shuning uchun toksikologik va genetik tekshiruvlar, klinik tarix va holat sharoitlarini o‘rganishni o‘z ichiga olgan keng qamrovli tekshiruv zarur.

source.author: du Long et al.
